events.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
events.blurb: Mick Jagger, the iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, having been born on July 26, 1943.

angles.name: Rock Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young and still moving like Jagger! Wishing a very happy birthday to the legendary Mick Jagger.

events.title: MTV launched with 'Video Killed The Radio Star'
events.blurb: On August 1, 1981, MTV made its debut, forever changing the music landscape with its first broadcast: The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star.'

angles.name: MTV's Iconic Debut
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, MTV launched with a song that ironically predicted its own impact. Remember the first video ever played?

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their groundbreaking debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994, solidifying their place in Britpop history.

angles.name: Britpop Milestone
angles.copy: A defining moment for Britpop! We're looking back at Oasis's iconic debut album, 'Definitely Maybe'. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal event in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace, Love & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million gathered for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: On the anniversary of his passing on August 16, 1977, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 this year, born January 8, 1935.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley's legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55
events.blurb: We remember Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot on September 7, 1996, in Las Vegas and passed away on September 13, 1996. Born on June 16, 1971, he would have been 55 this year.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering a voice that shaped a generation. Tupac's music and message still resonate deeply today.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: On this day, we pay tribute to the unparalleled guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on September 18, 1970, and would have been 84 this year, born November 27, 1942.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Celebrating the genius of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking sound continues to influence musicians worldwide.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring some of their most beloved tracks.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: That famous zebra crossing. Celebrating The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' – an album that's as iconic as its cover.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today, having been born on September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Rebel
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis, celebrates his 54th birthday today, having been born on September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Mad For It Birthday
angles.copy: You know the voice, you know the attitude. Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and enduring album 'Imagine' was originally released on October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine A World
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' remains a timeless anthem for peace. Reflecting on John Lennon's iconic album today.

events.title: First iPod Unveiled Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember life before this? Today marks the anniversary of the device that put a thousand songs in your pocket.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! What's your favourite Bond film, car, or theme song? Choose wisely, 007.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On his birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon, born October 9, 1940, who would have been 86 this year.

angles.name: Remembering A Visionary
angles.copy: A true visionary would have turned 86 today. John Lennon's message of peace and love continues to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor and comedian John Cleese, celebrated for his work with Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their experimental and self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The White Album Legacy
angles.copy: A diverse and daring masterpiece. Celebrating The Beatles' 'White Album' – an album that truly broke new ground.
